rejected_rule.statement: A creditor who has entered into a settlement in a Debt Conciliation Board for the payment of a debt which is secured by a mortgage bond, is entitled to institute a hypothecary action for the recovery of that debt.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Thus, in addition to the fact that a plain reading of section 43 (1) and a perusal of the other provisions of the Debt Conciliation Ordinance establish that a creditor who has entered into a settlement in a Debt Conciliation Board for the payment of a debt which is secured by a mortgage bond, is entitled to institute a hypothecary action for the recovery of that debt which is recorded in the settlement,
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 43 of the Debt Conciliation Ordinance
